findings.detail: The first cut checked the new claim but let a second stale SessionFile view append from its own ordinal under the same owner. SessionFile now binds the file identity and size and refuses a view whose bytes changed.

The first cut attempted to bind a not-yet-created session in the claim constructor. Empty-session initialization now leaves identity unset until the header write and keeps that identity across appends.
The second review pass found symlink and hard-link aliases could bypass the path-local claim. Both aliases now fail closed before the target is read or changed.

The first exact-SHA CI matrix exposed that a replaced session could reuse the same inode, so dev+ino alone did not detect it on Linux. SessionFile now holds the original descriptor and compares fstat with the current path lstat before append.

reviewed_evidence: Red first: tests/test_session_writer.py failed at import because pocketchat.session_writer did not exist, after the append boundary was wired to require it.

After implementation: 16 focused ownership tests passed, including two-process exclusion, one-path independence from a different path, stale claim, symlink and hard-link aliases, path replacement, cancellation, failure, initialization cleanup and zero provider requests for a refused writer.
Session, session-identity and kernel suites ran 129 tests OK.
Release/process documentation guard plus the writer tests ran 32 tests OK.
The repository full suite ran 1240 tests OK with CPython 3.13.9.
ruff check --select E9,F pocketchat tests passed; compileall and git diff --check passed.
The review walked the claim lifecycle, release-only-own-claim paths, existing session format compatibility and the untracked-file boundary.
Exact-SHA CI run 41754871088 failed the same replacement test on Python 3.9 and 3.13 Linux; after holding the file descriptor, the full 1240-test suite and focused 32-test gate passed again locally.
unverified_scope: Only macOS CPython 3.13.9 was run locally. CPython 3.9, Linux and Windows behavior; platform CI for this exact SHA; real provider traffic; package build/install; clean-room scan; tag and Release were not run.
